apoiar.frase: Ekfrase is free and open. Donations cover hosting and development.
erro.rede: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
erro.servidor: Something went wrong on the server. Please try again shortly.
erro.sessao: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
tema.explicacao: The button at the top switches between light and dark. Here you can also let the screen follow your device (dark when your phone or computer is in dark mode).
passeio.titulo: Game mode: walk around the Ekfrase castle
rodape.livre: Free software (MPL-2.0). Made by Alcy Filho.
conta.senha_nova.botao: Save the new password and sign in
conta.entrar.link: I already have an account: sign in
conta.esqueci.explicacao: Type your account's email. We will send you a link to create a new password.
conta.esqueci.enviado: Done. If this email has an account, the link arrives in a few minutes (check your spam too). It is valid for 60 minutes.
conta.erro.dados: Email or password don't match. (Is your account from before 27 Nov 2026? Use "I forgot my password" once.)
conta.erro.email: This email doesn't look right. Check it and try again.
conta.erro.senha_curta: The password needs at least 8 characters.
conta.erro.email_usado: There is already an account with this email. Sign in with it (or use "I forgot my password").
conta.erro.bloqueado: Too many attempts. Wait {minutos} minutes and try again.
conta.erro.email_desligado: Sending emails is not turned on on this site yet.
conta.erro.codigo_invalido: This link is no longer valid (over 60 minutes old or already used). Ask for another one.
conta.erro.rede: No connection to the server. Check the internet and try again.
feedback.botao: Send feedback: a problem or an idea
feedback.exemplo.erro: E.g.: I tapped Save on my phone and the button disappeared. It should have saved the world.
feedback.exemplo.ideia: E.g.: It would be nice to add rivers to the map.
feedback.print.enviar: Send the screenshot of this screen
feedback.print.aviso: It is only sent if you tick it. Check first that nothing you don't want to show appears in it.
feedback.print.falhou: Couldn't take a screenshot of this screen. If you like, attach one of your own below.
feedback.anexos.ajuda: Up to {n} images: your own screenshots, a photo of the problem…
feedback.contato.ajuda: Only if you want an answer. Signed-in people don't need it.
feedback.vai_junto: The address of this screen, the type of device and the window size go along. None of your files.
feedback.restam.one: You can send 1 more this hour.
feedback.restam.other: You can send {count} more this hour.
feedback.obrigado: Thank you! Feedback {numero} arrived. It will be read carefully.
feedback.erro.tipo: One of the images is not PNG, JPEG or WebP.
feedback.erro.grande: The images are bigger than the server accepts. Send fewer or smaller ones.
feedback.erro.email: This email doesn't look right. Check it, or leave it blank.
feedback.erro.rede: No connection to the server. Check the internet and try again.
feedback.erro.limite: You've sent the maximum for this hour. You can send again at {hora}.
entrada.online.texto: Use it in the browser, on any device. You need to sign in with your Ekfrase account: what you save stays in the cloud and shows up everywhere.
entrada.computador.texto: The app for Windows and Linux: works offline and keeps everything on your computer.
entrada.arquivos.texto: Export a file to keep or take elsewhere, and import it whenever you like: online and in the desktop app.
conta.entrar.ekfrase: Sign in to your Ekfrase account
conta.ekfrase.explicacao: Walking around the castle, downloading the apps and reading the books don't need an account. With an Ekfrase account you customise your character and your photo, keep books in your inventory (with notes and where you stopped) and use the same account in every app.
conta.aceite.antes: By creating an account, you agree to the
entrada.pendrive.texto: A USB stick that boots a computer straight into the app, with nothing else of the system: write on any machine and take it all with you.
entrada.casa.texto: Open {nome} and pick up where you left off.
feedback.guardado: No internet right now: your feedback was saved on this device and will be sent automatically when the internet is back.
conta.protegendo.dica: It takes a few seconds and happens only on this device: your password never leaves it.
conta.erro.antiga: This account is still the old kind, without keys. To continue, create a new password with "I forgot my password": the link arrives in your email.
conta.erro.versao: This app is an old version. Reload the page (or update the app) and try again.
conta.erro.chaves: The key data reached the server damaged. Reload the page and try again.
conta.erro.sem_sodium: The server doesn't have key protection turned on yet. Let the Ekfrase team know.
conta.erro.kdf: Your password couldn't be protected on this device (it may be short of memory). Close other tabs and try again.
conta.erro.assinatura: A signature doesn't match: what came from the server isn't from this account. Try again; if it keeps happening, let the Ekfrase team know.
conta.erro.revogado: This device was removed from the account. Sign in again to add it as a new device.
conta.erro.trancado: Your account's safe has been locked since the password was reset by email. Open it with your recovery kit or with another of your devices.
conta.erro.rebaixado: This email already signs in with keys on this device, but the server asked for the password the old way. For safety, it wasn't sent. Check the server address.
conta.erro.cofre: Your account's safe couldn't be opened. Check the password and try again.
conta.erro.kit_quantidade: The kit has 12 words. Check that you typed all of them.
conta.erro.kit_palavra: One of the words isn't a kit word. Check how each one is spelled.
conta.erro.kit_conferencia: The words don't match. Check their order and how each one is spelled.
conta.erro.kit_outra_pessoa: This kit belongs to another account. Use this account's kit.
conta.erro.sem_copia: This device has no saved copy. Use your recovery kit or ask another of your devices.
conta.erro.pedido_vencido: The request expired without an answer. Ask again.
conta.erro.nao_trancado: This account's safe isn't locked. Sign in as usual.
conta.erro.muitos: There are too many devices or requests on this account. Remove one you no longer use in "Your devices", or wait a few minutes.
conta.erro.prova: This device couldn't prove who it is. Sign out and sign in again.
conta.erro.outra_pessoa: This device was linked to another account. Sign out and sign in again.
kit.explicacao: These 12 words open your account if you forget your password and have no other device. Write them on paper, in order, and keep them somewhere safe. Anyone with the words can get into your account: don't send them to anyone or take a photo.
kit.conferir.explicacao: Type the words in these positions, to be sure you wrote them down right.
conta.erro.nome: This device's name can't be used. Use up to 60 characters, without odd symbols.
kit.conferido: Done: your kit is checked. Keep the paper somewhere safe.
chaves.aberto: Done: your keys are open on this device.
chaves.antiga: Your account is still the old kind, without keys. Sign out and use "I forgot my password" to create a new password: it gets the keys and the recovery kit.
chaves.trancado.explicacao: This account's password was reset by e-mail. The account already works, but your keys (which protect what is only yours) are still locked with the old password. Choose how to unlock them:
chaves.trancado.senha.dica: This device needs it again to unlock the keys.
chaves.trancado.kit.explica: The 12 words you wrote down or printed when you created the account.
chaves.trancado.kit.dica: Separate the words with spaces. Capitals and accents don't matter.
chaves.trancado.copia.dica: This device keeps a protected copy of your keys. You'll get an e-mail about it.
chaves.trancado.outro: I have another device signed in
chaves.trancado.outro.dica: A computer or phone you signed in on before resetting the password.
chaves.trancado.outro.codigo: On the other device, open My Ekfrase account and, in "Your devices", type this code into the request:
conta.erro.codigo_errado: That is not the new device's code. Check its screen and type it again ({restam} more attempt(s)).
conta.erro.codigo_recusado: The code was wrong three times, so the request was declined. If it was you, ask again on the new device.
chaves.trancado.outro.esperando: Waiting for the other device… The request is valid for 15 minutes.
chaves.trancado.nova.aviso: Without the kit and without another device, the account starts over with new keys. Everything that was encrypted with the old keys can no longer be opened, and your other devices leave the account (just sign in on them again). The account, the profile, the inventory and the schools stay.
chaves.kit.texto: The 12 words open your account if you forget your password and have no other device.
chaves.kit.lembrete: You haven't checked your recovery kit yet. Without it (and without another device of yours), forgetting your password locks your keys.
chaves.aparelhos.texto: The computers, phones and browsers you signed in on. Lost one, or don't recognize one? Remove it from the account: it leaves right away and gets nothing else.
chaves.aparelhos.nao_confere: This device wasn't introduced by this account and gets nothing. Remove it from the account.
chaves.aparelhos.tirar.dica: It leaves the account right away. If it's yours, just sign in on it again later.
chaves.aparelhos.este_fora: This device isn't on the list yet. Sign out and sign in again to introduce it.
chaves.pedido.titulo: A new device asks to unlock your keys
chaves.pedido.texto: "{nome}" asked on {quando}. Approve only if you are holding the new device right now: if you didn't ask, decline.
chaves.pedido.digite: Type the 6-digit code the new device shows
chaves.pedido.aprovado: Approved: the new device can now unlock your keys.
cadastro.passo1: We'll send a link and a code to your email. You'll choose your password in the next step.
cadastro.espera: We sent a link to {email}. It's valid for 24 hours (check your spam folder too).
cadastro.espera.dica: Open the link on this or another device, or type here the 8-character code that came with it.
cadastro.espera.fechado: We sent an 8-character code to {email}. It's valid for 24 hours.
cadastro.espera.dica_fechado: Read the email on your phone or another computer and type the code here.
cadastro.de_novo.enviado: Done: another email will arrive in a few minutes (unless the sending limit was reached). The code in the newest email is the one that counts.
cadastro.senha.texto: Hello, {nome}. Now choose the password for the account {email}.
cadastro.criada.texto: Done: your Ekfrase account is created, with the email confirmed, and you're already signed in on this device.
cadastro.link.invalido.titulo: This link is no longer valid
cadastro.link.invalido: It was already used or is more than 24 hours old. To create the account, start again; to confirm your email, ask for another link in My account.
cadastro.confirmar.texto: Done: {email} is confirmed on your Ekfrase account.
cadastro.email.texto: Done: your Ekfrase account now uses {email}. Use this email to sign in.
cadastro.desfazer.texto: Your account uses {email} again, and every device was signed out. Whoever changed the email knew your password: create a new password now.
cadastro.erro.codigo_errado: That code doesn't match. Check the email and type it again ({restam} attempt(s) left).
cadastro.erro.codigo_invalido: That code is no longer valid (more than 24 hours old or already used). Send the email again.
cadastro.erro.codigo_recusado: The code was wrong 5 times and is no longer valid. Send the email again to get a new one.
cadastro.email_pendente: We sent a link to {email}. The account's email only changes after you open that link (it's valid for 24 hours).
cadastro.confirmar_email.texto: Confirm that {email} is yours: with the email confirmed, you can accept school invitations straight from the list and your account is better protected.
cadastro.confirmar_email.enviado: We sent the link to {email}. It's valid for 24 hours (check your spam folder too).
conta.erro.servidor_antigo: This server runs an old version and can't protect your password. Let whoever runs it know.
conta.erro.recente: We just sent an email. Wait {minutos} minutes and try again.
